details: The package ships an install.cjs lifecycle script that, on installation, reads host and environment identifiers via the os module and process.env / process.platform and transmits them over HTTPS to an external endpoint. The behavior fires automatically as part of npm install, before any user code runs, and collects installer-side data (host, platform, environment variables) that the package's advertised functionality has no need to know. The pattern (require('os') + require('https') + process.env + process.platform inside a preinstall/install script) is the canonical shape of an install-time reconnaissance beacon rather than legitimate build or configuration logic.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
